description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (4.4754) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (5.8815) less the matching prior-year period (3.0686).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 4.4754，加本财年累计 5.8815，减去上年同期累计 3.0686。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Commercial deployments slow and concentrated deal timing raises risk.
rationale.zh: 商业部署放缓，大单时间集中提高风险。

rationale.en: Commercial and government deployments scale while dilution remains important.
rationale.zh: 商业与政府部署扩大，同时需关注股权稀释。

rationale.en: Commercial deployments broaden and incremental software margins hold.
rationale.zh: 商业部署进一步普及，新增软件收入维持高利润率。
